Answer: Stuttering is a learned behavior caused by criticism
Detail: Wendell Johnson believed that stuttering was not an organic or genetic condition, but a "diagnosogenic" one—meaning the diagnosis caused the disorder. He theorized that by labeling a child a "stutterer," you created the anxiety that led to the actual speech impediment.
